entries.title: A crewmate can fill in forms inside a page's frames
entries.body: Many sites put their payment form or sign-in box in a frame from another site. A crewmate's browser now reads and fills those too, and leaves a human check such as "Verify you are human" to you. When a site asks for a passkey, the browser now tells it at once that none is available, so the site offers a password or a code instead of waiting. A crewmate that asked you to take over its browser can also take the request back and keep its pages.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes: the crewmate reads and fills frames it could not reach before, and tells you what a site asked.
